title: DEF CON 30 - Sam Bent - Tor - Darknet Opsec By a Veteran Darknet Vendor
summary: A DEF CON 30 talk by Sam Bent, a former darknet vendor, on operational security when using Tor and the darknet. He applies the hacker mindset to staying anonymous and avoiding capture.
why: HN people recommend it for a first-hand view of how Tor holds up in practice, from someone who had to rely on it.

quote.text: Here is an awesome DefCon talk about this topic from the perspective of a darknet vendor. It's amazing
